lines: Jackson is listed as out for the season and has played 5 of Baltimore's 11 games. Jacoby Brissett is the starter, and our Wk 12 projection for Jackson is 0.0 PPR.
In his last 3 games he averaged 13.1 PPR points, down from 15.8 for the season. He threw 13.7 passes a game, down from 19.4.
The coach said Jackson has had surgery and gave no return timeline. On Nov 23 he said Jackson is in the early part of a process.
